description: This file defines API endpoints for a vector store service using FastAPI. It includes route handlers for searching, creating vector stores, and creating indexes, integrating with internal modules for request processing and database operations.

methods.description: Handles POST requests to search in a specified vector store, processing the request and returning search results.

methods.name: vector_store_create( request: Request, fastapi_response: Response, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new vector store, processing and saving the store details.

methods.name: index_create( request: Request, index_create_request: IndexCreateRequest, fastapi_response: Response, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
